full_judgment:
2. Facts necessary for disposal of the Rule, in short, are that the petitioner as plaintiff instituted Partition Suit No. 289 of 1980 in the Court of Subordinate Judge, 1st Court, Comilla for partition of the suit land contending inter-alia that his grandfather Mozu Gazi was the owner of the suit land who during his lifetime by way of a registered Heba deed dated 11-7-1914 gifted the suit land to his two sons namely Modhu Miah alias Kala Miah, father of the plaintiff, Asmat Ali and one daughter Khatoon Bibi and delivered the possession of the suit lands to them. The CS khatian was wrongly recorded in the name of Mozu Gazi in place of Asmat Ali, Modhu Miah and Khatoon Bibi,. Modhu Gazi died leaving behind one wife Manikjan Bibi, Asmat Ali and Modhu Miah as two sons, Khatoon Bibi as one daughter as his legal heirs. Manikjan got 1 decimal from Mozu Gazi as widow and she purchased 16 decimals from one Sona Miah, husband of Khatoon Bibi and thereby she got total 17 decimals of land. Asmat Ali died leaving the defendant Nos. 2 and 3 namely Jabbar Ali and Moidhar Ali as 2 sons and thereafter Jabbar Ali died leaving defendant Nos. 4-9 as his heirs. Moidhar Ali died leaving defendant Nos. 10-13 as his heirs. Khatoon Bibi died without issues leaving Modhu Miah as full brother and Sona Miah as husband. Modhu Miah purchased 16 decimals from Sona Miah by registered Kabala dated 16-1-1929 and got 1.80 acres by dint of inheritance from Khatoon Bibi and thereby Modhu Miah, father of the plaintiff got 2.36 acres by way of aforesaid Heba deed dated 11-7-1914, 2 decimals by way of inheritance from father, 16 decimals from Sona Miah and 1.80 acres from Khatoon Bibi, in aggregate 4.34 acres of land. Modhu Miah during his lifetime by way of registered Heba deed dated 3-10-1980 gifted the said 4.36 acres to plaintiff and defendant Nos. 15-17 four sons of Modhu Miah and delivered possession to them and thereby plaintiff is the owner and possessor of 1.09 acres on the total in the suit land, but the defendants are not willing to partition the suit land upon several tagids and thereby cause of action arose on 18-11-1980 and plaintiff filed the suit on 27-11-1980. 

 5. The defendant No. 3 ultimately supported the case of the plaintiff and stated that Mozu Gazi was the original owner of the suit land and that CS khatian was recorded correctly in the name of him and she also admitted that Mozu Gazi gifted the suit land to his two sons Modhu Miah and Asmat Ali and one daughter Khatoon Bibi by registered Heba deed dated 11-7-1914. Manikjan Bibi earlier was married to one Mozu Gazi and Khatoon Bibi died leaving behind two full brothers Asmat Ali and Modhu Miah and husband Sona Miah and she supported the case of the plaintiff and prayed for separate saham. 

 6. The case of the defendant Nos. 2, 5 and 12 is that Mozu Gazi was the original owner of the suit land and he gifted the suit land by registered Heba deed dated 11-7-1914 to his two sons Asmat Ali and Modhu Miah and one daughter Khatoon Bibi and delivered possession to them and the CS khatian was wrongly recorded in his name and that defendant No. 20 who is not the son of Mozu Gazi and that Khatoon Bibi died leaving Sona Miah as husband and Asmat Ali and Modhu Miah as two brothers as her heirs and that the suit was bad for defect of parties and Asmat Ali was the owner and possessor of 3.26 7/9 acres of land. They ultimately supported the case of the plaintiff but claimed that the suit is bad for defect of the parties and claimed their saham.
